For simplicity, # we escape everything and then unescape a few safe tags. # Here we permit , , , , and

. allowed_tags = {"b", "i", "u", "strong", "em", "p", "br"} # Escape the content first escaped_content = html.escape(post_content, quote=True) # Re‑introduce allowed tags import re def _unescape_allowed(match: re.Match) -> str: tag = match.group(1) return f"<{tag}>" if tag in allowed_tags else "" # Pattern to find escaped tags like <b> pattern = re.compile(r"<(/?)([a-zA-Z0-9]+)>") safe_content = pattern.sub(lambda m: f"<{m.group(1)}{m.group(2)}>" if m.group(2) in allowed_tags else "", escaped_content) # Build tag spans safe_tag_spans = [] for tag in post_tags: if not isinstance(tag, str): continue # skip non-string tags escaped_tag = html.escape(tag, quote=True) safe_tag_spans.append(f'{escaped_tag}') tags_html = " ".join(safe_tag_spans) # Render the final HTML return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( user_name=safe_user_name, post_heading=safe_heading, post_content=safe_content, post_tags=tags_html )
